race.description: Tobin Brothers Celebrating Lives F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: Siding with the unraced ones and TRANSIENCE (12) gets the nod. She's a filly by Shamus Award for the Freedman yard who has jumped out well enough to make an immediate impact over a suitable trip from a good draw. KAZEKAGE (10) is a filly by Snitzel on debut for the Mark Walker yard. She's also jumped out well and has claims. OCEAN MIRAGE (11) was $31 on debut at Geelong but ran a good race for third behind Lafarna who was a short priced favourite and is in the market in a Listed race on Saturday. Expecting that form to hold up nicely. FIVE ROSES (8) didn't fire on debut at Seymour but that was a fairly deep maiden and she should be improved, each way.
